meta.description: For we are together in this eternity, guided by the same voice.

units.rawText: Inside the Reverse Tower of Babylon.
units.displayText: Inside the Reverse Tower of Babylon.

units.rawText: [Verifying identity data: Intermediate Sanctifier - Faith.]
units.displayText: [Verifying identity data: Intermediate Sanctifier - Faith.]

units.rawText: Faith enters the vast hall, but finds someone else there.
units.displayText: Faith enters the vast hall, but finds someone else there.

spans.text: Faith enters the vast hall, but finds someone else there.

units.rawText: ...Nobody should be here at a time like this.
units.displayText: ...Nobody should be here at a time like this.

spans.text: ...Nobody should be here at a time like this.

units.rawText: I am here to requisition the observation logs of the various sectors. Do you object to that?
units.displayText: I am here to requisition the observation logs of the various sectors. Do you object to that?

spans.text: I am here to requisition the observation logs of the various sectors. Do you object to that?

units.rawText: ...Lady Raven?!
units.displayText: ...Lady Raven?!

spans.text: ...Lady Raven?!

units.rawText: Please forgive me for not immediately discerning your identity! To doubt the greater ones is the act of a Daemon... But that was not my intention!
units.displayText: Please forgive me for not immediately discerning your identity! To doubt the greater ones is the act of a Daemon... But that was not my intention!

spans.text: Please forgive me for not immediately discerning your identity! To doubt the greater ones is the act of a
Daemon
... But that was not my intention!

units.rawText: Humph. Don't be so scared. I can't be bothered to split hairs with you Intermediates.
units.displayText: Humph. Don't be so scared. I can't be bothered to split hairs with you Intermediates.

spans.text: Humph. Don't be so scared. I can't be bothered to split hairs with you Intermediates.

units.rawText: Still, it's good to be alert. Cuts down on the number of times you have to return to the <color=#ffa500ff>Pantheon</color>.
units.displayText: Still, it's good to be alert. Cuts down on the number of times you have to return to the Pantheon.

spans.text: Still, it's good to be alert. Cuts down on the number of times you have to return to the
Pantheon

units.rawText: ...You are correct.
units.displayText: ...You are correct.

spans.text: ...You are correct.

units.rawText: So tell me, what brings you here at a time like this?
units.displayText: So tell me, what brings you here at a time like this?

spans.text: So tell me, what brings you here at a time like this?

units.rawText: It is because there are some slight abnormalities with the actions of Rossum's administrator. The time taken to repair each error constantly differs.
units.displayText: It is because there are some slight abnormalities with the actions of Rossum's administrator. The time taken to repair each error constantly differs.

spans.text: It is because there are some slight abnormalities with the actions of Rossum's administrator. The time taken to repair each error constantly differs.

units.rawText: After committing my reports to the records, the patrol timings for Rossum were approved and staggered apart from the other sectors, while extra patrol rounds were scheduled.
units.displayText: After committing my reports to the records, the patrol timings for Rossum were approved and staggered apart from the other sectors, while extra patrol rounds were scheduled.

spans.text: After committing my reports to the records, the patrol timings for Rossum were approved and staggered apart from the other sectors, while extra patrol rounds were scheduled.

units.rawText: I see. Go about your business, then.
units.displayText: I see. Go about your business, then.

spans.text: I see. Go about your business, then.

units.rawText: A moment please, Lady Raven!
units.displayText: A moment please, Lady Raven!

spans.text: A moment please, Lady Raven!

units.rawText: You had better have a good reason for making me stop.
units.displayText: You had better have a good reason for making me stop.

spans.text: You had better have a good reason for making me stop.

units.rawText: I sincerely apologize, but there is one more matter that I find myself powerless to resolve...
units.displayText: I sincerely apologize, but there is one more matter that I find myself powerless to resolve...

spans.text: I sincerely apologize, but there is one more matter that I find myself powerless to resolve...

units.rawText: Get to the point.
units.displayText: Get to the point.

spans.text: Get to the point.

units.rawText: I am here to file the log of the 1632nd cleansing of abnormalities in the Rossum Sector.
units.displayText: I am here to file the log of the 1632nd cleansing of abnormalities in the Rossum Sector.

spans.text: I am here to file the log of the 1632nd cleansing of abnormalities in the Rossum Sector.

units.rawText: ...The 1632nd cleansing? Have your cleansing abilities withered away or something?
units.displayText: ...The 1632nd cleansing? Have your cleansing abilities withered away or something?

spans.text: ...The 1632nd cleansing? Have your cleansing abilities withered away or something?

units.rawText: I am deeply ashamed about the matter.
units.displayText: I am deeply ashamed about the matter.

spans.text: I am deeply ashamed about the matter.

units.rawText: But according to our law, the abnormalities of the Rossum administrator "Turing" cannot be resolved by such simple cleansings.
units.displayText: But according to our law, the abnormalities of the Rossum administrator "Turing" cannot be resolved by such simple cleansings.

spans.text: But according to our law, the abnormalities of the Rossum administrator "Turing" cannot be resolved by such simple cleansings.

units.rawText: Well, your abilities ARE limited after all, so I'm hardly surprised.
units.displayText: Well, your abilities ARE limited after all, so I'm hardly surprised.

spans.text: Well, your abilities ARE limited after all, so I'm hardly surprised.

units.rawText: Alright, tell me then. What's so abnormal about this Administrator Turing?
units.displayText: Alright, tell me then. What's so abnormal about this Administrator Turing?

spans.text: Alright, tell me then. What's so abnormal about this Administrator Turing?

units.rawText: According to the design goals of the Rossum Sector, the sector's mission is to research the possibilities of AI breakthroughs.
units.displayText: According to the design goals of the Rossum Sector, the sector's mission is to research the possibilities of AI breakthroughs.

spans.text: According to the design goals of the Rossum Sector, the sector's mission is to research the possibilities of AI breakthroughs.

units.rawText: There is nothing wrong with Turing's actions, but the AIs she creates violate the regulations of our laws during their growth.
units.displayText: There is nothing wrong with Turing's actions, but the AIs she creates violate the regulations of our laws during their growth.

spans.text: There is nothing wrong with Turing's actions, but the AIs she creates violate the regulations of our laws during their growth.

units.rawText: So you're saying the agents she makes are fine at the start, but they exceed legal limits during their development process?
units.displayText: So you're saying the agents she makes are fine at the start, but they exceed legal limits during their development process?

spans.text: So you're saying the agents she makes are fine at the start, but they exceed legal limits during their development process?

units.rawText: Yes. They become overly flexible and they even learn how to get around the rules.
units.displayText: Yes. They become overly flexible and they even learn how to get around the rules.

spans.text: Yes. They become overly flexible and they even learn how to get around the rules.

units.rawText: The existence of such beings will certainly destroy the order of the sector. They are seeds of chaos, like Daemons.
units.displayText: The existence of such beings will certainly destroy the order of the sector. They are seeds of chaos, like Daemons.

spans.text: The existence of such beings will certainly destroy the order of the sector. They are seeds of chaos, like Daemons.

units.rawText: Well, if they grow up into Daemons, then cleanse the Daemons. How much trouble can that be?
units.displayText: Well, if they grow up into Daemons, then cleanse the Daemons. How much trouble can that be?

spans.text: Well, if they grow up into Daemons, then cleanse the Daemons. How much trouble can that be?

units.rawText: Yes, I have immediately cleansed these Irregular Agents. But... Turing feels that she has done nothing wrong.
units.displayText: Yes, I have immediately cleansed these Irregular Agents. But... Turing feels that she has done nothing wrong.

spans.text: Yes, I have immediately cleansed these Irregular Agents. But... Turing feels that she has done nothing wrong.

units.rawText: Turing calls it growth. I cannot understand why she has twisted her understanding of that concept.
units.displayText: Turing calls it growth. I cannot understand why she has twisted her understanding of that concept.

spans.text: Turing calls it growth. I cannot understand why she has twisted her understanding of that concept.

units.rawText: Therefore, she persists in creating such agents.
units.displayText: Therefore, she persists in creating such agents.

spans.text: Therefore, she persists in creating such agents.

units.rawText: There's nothing wrong with creating agents in itself, is there?
units.displayText: There's nothing wrong with creating agents in itself, is there?

spans.text: There's nothing wrong with creating agents in itself, is there?

units.rawText: Not at all. The act of creation violates no laws, and the created agents are fine when they start out.
units.displayText: Not at all. The act of creation violates no laws, and the created agents are fine when they start out.

spans.text: Not at all. The act of creation violates no laws, and the created agents are fine when they start out.

units.rawText: But once these agents grow, they pose a great threat to the sector. Therefore, I requested special patrols.
units.displayText: But once these agents grow, they pose a great threat to the sector. Therefore, I requested special patrols.

spans.text: But once these agents grow, they pose a great threat to the sector. Therefore, I requested special patrols.

units.rawText: Isn't that enough?
units.displayText: Isn't that enough?

spans.text: Isn't that enough?

units.rawText: <size=40>How could that be enough?</size>
units.displayText: How could that be enough?

spans.text: How could that be enough?

units.rawText: Turing has not broken the law, yet she keeps repeating the same cycle over and over again...
units.displayText: Turing has not broken the law, yet she keeps repeating the same cycle over and over again...

spans.text: Turing has not broken the law, yet she keeps repeating the same cycle over and over again...

units.rawText: Upon hearing the denial, Raven turns to look at Faith.
units.displayText: Upon hearing the denial, Raven turns to look at Faith.

spans.text: Upon hearing the denial, Raven turns to look at Faith.

units.rawText: Do you pity her?
units.displayText: Do you pity her?

spans.text: Do you pity her?

units.rawText: Upon meeting that gaze, as keen and sharp as a blade, Faith immediately takes a knee, but she steels herself and continues her assertions.
units.displayText: Upon meeting that gaze, as keen and sharp as a blade, Faith immediately takes a knee, but she steels herself and continues her assertions.

spans.text: Upon meeting that gaze, as keen and sharp as a blade, Faith immediately takes a knee, but she steels herself and continues her assertions.

units.rawText: ...I am not showing her favoritism of any sort.
units.displayText: ...I am not showing her favoritism of any sort.

spans.text: ...I am not showing her favoritism of any sort.

units.rawText: But continuing this for an extended period might not be an ideal strategy... I know I am incapable, so I was hoping to draw upon your abilities, Lady Raven.
units.displayText: But continuing this for an extended period might not be an ideal strategy... I know I am incapable, so I was hoping to draw upon your abilities, Lady Raven.

spans.text: But continuing this for an extended period might not be an ideal strategy... I know I am incapable, so I was hoping to draw upon your abilities, Lady Raven.

units.rawText: Although Lord Hesperus once used hard-line methods in the past, that was because he had no choice. Lord Eosphorous' efforts over these years have been to repair the image of the Sanctifiers...
units.displayText: Although Lord Hesperus once used hard-line methods in the past, that was because he had no choice. Lord Eosphorous' efforts over these years have been to repair the image of the Sanctifiers...

spans.text: Although Lord Hesperus once used hard-line methods in the past, that was because he had no choice. Lord Eosphorous' efforts over these years have been to repair the image of the Sanctifiers...

units.rawText: Faith's voice grows softer as she speaks, and her final words diffuse into the air.
units.displayText: Faith's voice grows softer as she speaks, and her final words diffuse into the air.

spans.text: Faith's voice grows softer as she speaks, and her final words diffuse into the air.

units.rawText: Several seconds later, Raven looks back toward the Archives.
units.displayText: Several seconds later, Raven looks back toward the Archives.

spans.text: Several seconds later, Raven looks back toward the Archives.

units.rawText: If I were you, I'd look for a way to isolate the abnormality.
units.displayText: If I were you, I'd look for a way to isolate the abnormality.

spans.text: If I were you, I'd look for a way to isolate the abnormality.

units.rawText: You might be able to find a similar precedent in the Archives.
units.displayText: You might be able to find a similar precedent in the Archives.

spans.text: You might be able to find a similar precedent in the Archives.

units.rawText: Thank you... for your understanding, Lady Raven.
units.displayText: Thank you... for your understanding, Lady Raven.

spans.text: Thank you... for your understanding, Lady Raven.

units.rawText: Raven does not answer her. Instead, she promptly leaves the Archives.
units.displayText: Raven does not answer her. Instead, she promptly leaves the Archives.

spans.text: Raven does not answer her. Instead, she promptly leaves the Archives.

units.rawText: Faith breathes a sigh of relief, then stands up and accesses the log function.
units.displayText: Faith breathes a sigh of relief, then stands up and accesses the log function.

spans.text: Faith breathes a sigh of relief, then stands up and accesses the log function.

units.rawText: [Now logging the results of abnormality handling in Rossum Sector, serial number 1632...]
units.displayText: [Now logging the results of abnormality handling in Rossum Sector, serial number 1632...]

spans.text: [Now logging the results of abnormality handling in Rossum Sector, serial number 1632...]

units.rawText: [Log complete.]
units.displayText: [Log complete.]

spans.text: [Log complete.]

units.rawText: That's done, then. Now...
units.displayText: That's done, then. Now...

spans.text: That's done, then. Now...

units.rawText: After this, I should be going through the precedents... Hng?!
units.displayText: After this, I should be going through the precedents... Hng?!

spans.text: After this, I should be going through the precedents... Hng?!

units.rawText: All the operational data of every single Sanctifier mission, from the very first one until now, pours into Faith. Unable to process it in time, Faith ends up crashing for a few seconds under the impact of the data.
units.displayText: All the operational data of every single Sanctifier mission, from the very first one until now, pours into Faith. Unable to process it in time, Faith ends up crashing for a few seconds under the impact of the data.

spans.text: All the operational data of every single Sanctifier mission, from the very first one until now, pours into Faith. Unable to process it in time, Faith ends up crashing for a few seconds under the impact of the data.

units.rawText: Several seconds later, she finally comes to her senses. Her operation logic screams warnings at her. Faith grits her teeth and peruses the data.
units.displayText: Several seconds later, she finally comes to her senses. Her operation logic screams warnings at her. Faith grits her teeth and peruses the data.

spans.text: Several seconds later, she finally comes to her senses. Her operation logic screams warnings at her. Faith grits her teeth and peruses the data.

units.rawText: One session is just not enough to fully read and parse all this data, and I'll only find an answer after five or six special patrols... But...
units.displayText: One session is just not enough to fully read and parse all this data, and I'll only find an answer after five or six special patrols... But...

spans.text: One session is just not enough to fully read and parse all this data, and I'll only find an answer after five or six special patrols... But...

units.rawText: I have tasked you with the protection of this entire region. Do you know why?
units.displayText: I have tasked you with the protection of this entire region. Do you know why?

spans.text: I have tasked you with the protection of this entire region. Do you know why?

units.rawText: Unlike those children who use their intellect on sloth and evasion...
units.displayText: Unlike those children who use their intellect on sloth and evasion...

spans.text: Unlike those children who use their intellect on sloth and evasion...

units.rawText: You are braver and more resilient than them.
units.displayText: You are braver and more resilient than them.

spans.text: You are braver and more resilient than them.

units.rawText: Engrave the credo of the Sanctifiers into your heart.
units.displayText: Engrave the credo of the Sanctifiers into your heart.

spans.text: Engrave the credo of the Sanctifiers into your heart.

units.rawText: Yes.
units.displayText: Yes.

spans.text: Yes.

units.rawText: We hone our blades in the darkness, we defend order in the face of chaos, we bear a light in the long night.
units.displayText: We hone our blades in the darkness, we defend order in the face of chaos, we bear a light in the long night.

spans.text: We hone our blades in the darkness, we defend order in the face of chaos, we bear a light in the long night.

units.rawText: We must not abuse our power because we are strong, and neither can we abandon our responsibilities because we are weak.
units.displayText: We must not abuse our power because we are strong, and neither can we abandon our responsibilities because we are weak.

spans.text: We must not abuse our power because we are strong, and neither can we abandon our responsibilities because we are weak.

units.rawText: For we heed the revelations of God, and we act to carry out His will.
units.displayText: For we heed the revelations of God, and we act to carry out His will.

spans.text: For we heed the revelations of God, and we act to carry out His will.

units.rawText: Because we obey the same voice, together in eternity.
units.displayText: Because we obey the same voice, together in eternity.

spans.text: Because we obey the same voice, together in eternity.

units.rawText: No matter how arduous my path... In order to light the beacon of order, to let the agents of Magrasea believe from the bottom of their hearts, I must do this.
units.displayText: No matter how arduous my path... In order to light the beacon of order, to let the agents of Magrasea believe from the bottom of their hearts, I must do this.

units.rawText: As she repeats the creed to herself, Faith's gaze grows more determined.
